ja: 私は音読を勧めます。
en: I recommend reading aloud.
alternatives: I suggest reading out loud.
My advice is to read aloud.
point: recommend の後の行動は動名詞。

ja: 私たちに嫌味な褒め言葉は不要だった。
en: You could've spared us that backhanded compliment.
alternatives: You didn't need to give us that backhanded compliment.
You could've kept that backhanded compliment to yourself.
point: could have spared は避けてほしかったという遠回しな非難。

ja: 早く言ってくれたら手伝ったよ。
en: I'd have helped if you'd asked.
alternatives: If you'd told me earlier, I'd have helped.
If you'd said something, I'd have helped.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had + 過去分詞

ja: 今、指摘を読み返してる。
en: I'm rereading your comments.
alternatives: I'm going over your comments now.
I'm reading your comments again.
point: 今している最中は be + 動詞ing

ja: これが私の資料なら、無駄を削るのに。
en: If this were mine, I'd cut the fluff.
alternatives: If this were my report, I'd trim the fat.
If it were my document, I'd cut the fluff.
If this were mine, I'd trim the fat.
point: 「無駄を削る」は cut the fluff / trim the fat

ja: 部長は、企画が性急だと言ってたよ。
en: Our director said the plan felt rushed.
alternatives: The director told me the plan felt rushed.
Our director said the plan was rushed.
point: said の後は過去形に合わせる（時制の一致）

ja: その写真を使って。
en: Use that photo.
alternatives: Put that photo in.
Include that photo.
point: use の命令形で使うよう依頼する。

ja: 君が入れた例は適切だ。
en: The example you added is appropriate.
alternatives: The example you included is appropriate.
The example you added fits well.
point: you added がどの例かを説明する。

ja: 構成は見直した方がいいかもね。
en: You might want to rethink the structure.
alternatives: You might want to rework the structure.
Maybe you could rethink the structure a bit.
point: might want to で提案を柔らかくする

ja: コメント送ってもいい？
en: Can I send you comments?
alternatives: Could I send you comments?
May I send you my comments?
point: send + 人 + 物 の語順。人は you

ja: 印象的だったのは、君の冷静さだ。
en: What struck me was your composure.
alternatives: What impressed me was how calm you stayed.
What stood out to me was your composure.
point: 「印象に残った」は strike / stand out

ja: ここ、少し分かりにくいかも。
en: This part might be a bit unclear.
alternatives: This part may be a little hard to follow.
This bit could be a little unclear.
point: might と a bit で指摘を和らげる

ja: 感心するのは、発想でなくやり切る力です。
en: It's the follow-through, not the idea, that impresses me.
alternatives: What impresses me is the follow-through, not the idea.
It's your follow-through, not your idea, that impresses me.
The follow-through impresses me more than the idea.
point: It's〜that で強調。「やり切る力」は follow-through

ja: 君の説明は私を助けた。
en: Your explanation helped me.
alternatives: You helped me with your explanation.
I benefited from your explanation.
point: helped me は私の理解を助けた。

ja: こんな完成度の下書き、初めて見たよ。
en: Never have I seen such a polished draft.
alternatives: I've never seen such a polished draft.
Never have I seen a draft this polished.
point: Never を前に出すと助動詞が主語の前に来る

ja: すばらしい発表だったよ。
en: That was a great presentation.
alternatives: That was an excellent presentation.
That was a really great presentation.
point: 単数の可算名詞には a が必要

ja: 君がいなければ失敗してた。
en: I'd have failed without you.
alternatives: Without you, I would have failed.
If not for you, I'd have failed.
point: If not for you は過去の仮定の言い方

ja: 君の指摘で、やり方を見直したよ。
en: Your comment made me rethink my approach.
alternatives: Your feedback got me to rethink my approach.
Your point made me reconsider my approach.
point: make + 人 + 原形で「〜させた」

ja: 君の声は前より明瞭。
en: Your voice is clearer.
alternatives: Your voice sounds clearer.
You sound clearer now.
point: clearer は clear の比較級。

ja: 君の見出しは褒められた。
en: Your heading was praised.
alternatives: Your heading received praise.
People praised your heading.
point: was praised で褒められた側を主語にする。

ja: レイアウト、君の話で納得した。
en: You've won me over on the layout.
alternatives: Your argument won me over on the layout.
You've convinced me about the layout.
point: 「納得させる」は win 人 over

ja: もっと早く指摘してほしかった。
en: I wish you'd flagged that earlier.
alternatives: I wish you'd pointed it out sooner.
I wish you had raised that earlier.
point: 過去の残念さは wish + 過去完了

ja: 冒頭がすごくよかったよ。
en: Your opening was really good.
alternatives: I really liked your opening.
Your opening was great.
point: 過去の評価は was で言う

ja: やや長いものの、いい出来。
en: It's good, though a bit long.
alternatives: It's good, although it's a bit long.
It's a bit long, but it's good.
point: though は文末や途中に添えて対比を出せる

ja: いい点が二つあるよ。
en: There are two good points.
alternatives: I see two good points.
Two points are good.
point: 複数は There are。point は複数形 points

ja: 最近、ずいぶん上達したね。
en: You've improved a lot lately.
alternatives: You've gotten a lot better lately.
You've improved so much lately.
point: 最近の変化は現在完了で言う

ja: もっと短くできるよ。
en: You can shorten it.
alternatives: You can make it shorter.
You could shorten it.
point: 「できる」は can + 動詞の原形

ja: 例を足すといいよ。
en: You should add examples.
alternatives: I'd add some examples.
Try adding some examples.
point: 軽い助言は should。must は強すぎる

ja: 例がもっとあるといいんだけど。
en: I wish there were more examples.
alternatives: I wish there were a few more examples.
I'd like to see more examples.
point: 今の希望は wish + 過去形。were を使う

ja: 読んで、気になる点が一つあるよ。
en: Having read it, I have one concern.
alternatives: Having gone through it, I have one concern.
Having read it, there's one thing that concerns me.
point: Having + 過去分詞で「読み終えて」を先に置く

ja: 具体例を足してほしいんだけど。
en: I'd like you to add examples.
alternatives: Could you add some examples?
I'd like you to include more examples.
point: want + 人 + to do の形

ja: 君の案、採用されたよ。
en: Your idea was accepted.
alternatives: Your proposal was approved.
Your idea got accepted.
point: された は was + 過去分詞で受け身にする

ja: よくやってるね。
en: You're doing great.
alternatives: You're doing well.
You're doing a great job.
point: 「今うまくやっている」は You're doing

ja: 私なら、潔く受け止めるのに。
en: Were it me, I'd take it on the chin.
alternatives: If it were me, I'd take it on the chin.
If I were you, I'd take it on the chin.
If I were in your position, I'd just accept it.
point: 「潔く受け止める」は take it on the chin

ja: 何を直せばいいですか？
en: What should I fix?
alternatives: What do I need to fix?
What should I change?
point: 「どうすれば」でなく what + should + 主語

ja: 指摘の点、すぐ直します。
en: I'll fix that right away.
alternatives: I'll fix that immediately.
I'll correct that right away.
point: その場で決めた対応は will

ja: 君の文章は前より滑らかだ。
en: Your prose flows more smoothly.
alternatives: Your writing flows more smoothly.
Your prose reads more smoothly.
point: flows more smoothly は文章の流れが更に自然なこと。

ja: 私は色の使い方を見直すよ。
en: I'll reconsider the color scheme.
alternatives: I'll rethink the color scheme.
I'll review how colors are used.
point: reconsider は一度決めた選択を考え直す。

ja: 君の図は役に立つ。
en: Your chart helps.
alternatives: Your chart is helpful.
Your chart is useful.
point: helps は図が理解を助けるという意味。

ja: 原稿、見てくれてありがと。
en: Thanks for reviewing my draft.
alternatives: Thank you for reviewing my draft.
Thanks for looking over my draft.
point: for の後ろは ~ing

ja: 表の下の注記が役立つ。
en: The note below the table helps.
alternatives: The note beneath the table is useful.
The note under the table is helpful.
point: below the table で注記の場所を後ろから修飾する。

ja: 君が直した所、まだ変だと彼は言う。
en: He says what you fixed still looks off.
alternatives: He says the part you fixed is still off.
He's saying the bit you fixed still looks off.
point: says の後ろの節の中にさらに what 節が入る

ja: 私が言葉を濁してたら君は今も気づかない。
en: Had I equivocated, you'd be none the wiser.
alternatives: If I'd been evasive, you still wouldn't know.
You'd still be unaware if I'd been evasive.
point: equivocate は言葉を濁す、none the wiser は分からないまま。

ja: 感想をもらえますか？
en: Could I get feedback?
alternatives: Can I get some feedback?
Could you give me feedback?
point: feedback は数えられない名詞。a は付けない

ja: 君は数か月、本当に頑張ってるね。
en: You've been working really hard for months.
alternatives: You've been putting in the effort for months.
You've been working so hard these past months.
point: 続いている努力は現在完了進行形

ja: 君の締めは磨く余地がある。
en: Your closing has room to improve.
alternatives: There's room to improve your closing.
Your closing could use some improvement.
point: room to improve は改善の余地を表す。

ja: 彼女は私の褒め方が少し偉そうと言った。
en: She said my praise sounded faintly patronizing.
alternatives: She said my compliments sounded slightly condescending.
She said my praise sounded a little patronizing.
point: faintly patronizing はかすかに上から目線の。

ja: 要点を絞れと言われた。
en: I was told to be concise.
alternatives: I was told to be brief.
They asked me to keep it short.
point: tell + 人 + to do

ja: 要点が埋もれたら私が言う。
en: I'll flag points if they're buried.
alternatives: I'll highlight key points if they're buried.
I'll mention key points if they're buried.
point: if 節は未来の条件でも現在形にする。

ja: 前回の点、直してくれたね。
en: You fixed what I flagged last time.
alternatives: You fixed the points I raised last time.
You fixed what I pointed out last time.
point: last time と一緒なら過去形。現在完了は使えない

ja: 何がまずかったか、教えて？
en: Can you tell me what went wrong?
alternatives: Could you tell me what went wrong?
Can you tell me what was wrong?
point: 間接疑問は主語動詞の語順のまま
